title: Board report generation and download silently fail for every report built from a custom (non-system) template — `getTemplateById()` called without the available `organizationId`, which restricts the lookup to system templates only
description:
**Files:** `vciso-service/src/services/ReportGeneratorService.ts:223` (`generateReport`), `:348` (`generateReportForStream`); `vciso-service/src/repositories/report.repository.ts:452-465` (`getTemplateById`)
**Root Cause:** `getTemplateById(templateId, organizationId?)`'s own docstring explains the contract precisely: `organizationId` is "required for IDOR prevention" — when provided, it allows the org's own custom templates OR system templates; when OMITTED, it deliberately falls back to `{ _id: templateId, isSystemTemplate: true }`, i.e. **system templates only**. Both call sites that actually generate/stream a report — `generateReport` (line 223: `this.reportRepo.getTemplateById(report.templateId)`) and `generateReportForStream` (line 348: identical call) — invoke this method with only one argument, silently dropping the `organizationId` that is already in scope as a parameter of both enclosing functions (used elsewhere in the same function for `collectReportData`). Confirmed via a repo-wide search: these are the only two call sites feeding actual report generation/download, and neither passes org context.
**Impact:** For any report whose `templateId` points at a custom, org-created template (`isSystemTemplate: false` — a real, reachable feature via `BoardReportingService.createTemplate`/the frontend's `TemplateEditorModal.jsx`), the lookup always returns `null` (it only matches system templates), so both `generateReport` and `generateReportForStream` immediately fail with `'Template not found'` / return `null`. Practically: any organisation that creates its own custom board-report template can never actually generate or download a report built from it — the feature silently breaks for the exact customization path it exists to support, while reports built from the built-in system templates work fine, making this easy to miss in a superficial test pass. This is the highest-risk artifact in the module per this agent's own severity guidance.
**Claude Fix Prompt:**
```
File: vciso-service/src/services/ReportGeneratorService.ts

1. Line 223 (generateReport): change `this.reportRepo.getTemplateById(report.templateId)` to `this.reportRepo.getTemplateById(report.templateId, new ObjectId(organizationId))` — organizationId is already a parameter of generateReport, in scope at this line.
2. Line 348 (generateReportForStream): change `this.reportRepo.getTemplateById(report.templateId)` to `this.reportRepo.getTemplateById(report.templateId, new ObjectId(organizationId))` — same fix, organizationId is already a parameter of generateReportForStream.
3. Add a regression test: create a custom (non-system) template for org A, create a report referencing it, call generateReport/generateReportForStream, assert the template is found and generation succeeds — this exact scenario currently fails silently and would have caught the bug.
4. Grep the rest of the codebase for any other getTemplateById(x) single-argument call sites that should be generating/streaming real org content (as opposed to a genuinely org-agnostic system-template-only lookup) and apply the same fix.
```
